course: DE 301: Data for ML & Retrieval Pipelines
context: Data correctness for ML plus text-pipeline construction. Feature pipelines and stores (offline training vs online serving), point-in-time correctness and time-travel joins, label leakage, training-serving skew, dataset versioning; parsing/extraction as pipeline stages, MinHash/SimHash and LSH mechanics for near-duplicate detection (the mechanics IR 102 deferred), language ID and quality filtering; chunk-and-embed as an idempotent batch job, vectors beside metadata, pre-filter vs post-filter ANN; vector databases as a product category (index types by OPERATIONAL profile, sync with the source of truth as the real hard problem, when you do not need one).

topics: Feature Pipelines: From Raw Events to Model Inputs
Feature Stores: Offline Training vs Online Serving
laterLessonsCover: 02 Temporal Correctness: Point-in-Time Correctness and Time-Travel Joins, Label Leakage: Learning from the Future, Training-Serving Skew
03 Dataset Versioning and Reproducibility: Versioning Datasets Alongside Models, Reproducible Training Data: Snapshots over Live Queries

04 Text Pipeline Construction: Parsing and Extraction as Pipeline Stages, MinHash and SimHash for Near-Duplicate Detection, LSH: Finding Near-Duplicates Without All-Pairs Comparison, Language ID and Quality Filtering
05 Embedding and Vector Pipelines: Chunk-and-Embed as an Idempotent Batch Job, Storing Vectors Beside Metadata, Pre-Filter vs Post-Filter in ANN Search
06 Vector Databases as a Product Category: ANN Index Types by Operational Profile, Keeping the Vector Store in Sync with the Source of Truth, When You Do Not Need a Vector Database
